items.title: The Stock Market Faces a Triple Threat. It Can Emerge Victorious.
items.summary: The stock market is facing a triple threat to start the week, but there’s reason to hope it can overcome all three of its nemeses.  Oil prices and bond yields are putting stocks under pressure, while artificial-intelligence safety fears are also back.  Brent crude  prices have jumped around 4% back above $100 a barrel after the U.S. and Iran failed to broker a deal to end the war in the Middle East.

items.title: 3 S&P 500 Stocks We Think Twice About
items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is often seen as a benchmark for strong businesses, but that doesn’t mean every stock is worth owning. Some companies face significant challenges, whether it’s stagnating growth, heavy debt, or disruptive new competitors.

items.title: 3 Consumer Stocks We’re Skeptical Of
items.summary: Retailers are adapting their business models as technology changes how people shop. Still, secular trends are working against them as e-commerce continues to take share from brick-and-mortar stores. This puts retail stocks in a tough spot, and over the past six months, the industry’s 1.2% gain has trailed the S&P 500 by 15.7 percentage points.
